It adds $105,719.61 and raises the contract limit from $1,031,410.80 to $1,137,130.40. The period is January 12 through June 30, 2022. This is the second of two similar amendments.

output.headline: Extends Kidango's Castlemont High lease to June 2023 and adds $18,000 in rent, up to $54,000 total
output.summary: Kidango, Inc. will keep using Buildings H and I at Castlemont High School for an early childhood education and family support program for low-income children. This amendment adds $18,000 in payments to the district, raising the cap on what Kidango pays to $54,000. It also extends the lease from June 30, 2022 to June 30, 2023.

output.headline: Adopts a resolution on the Measure G1 commission's 2022-23 middle school grant and spending plan
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution on the recommendation of the Measure G1 Oversight Commission (the Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act commission) for the 2022-2023 Middle Schools Grant Application and Education Spending Plan (Award). The text does not state a dollar amount or which schools are involved.

output.headline: Proclaims September 2022 as LGBTQ Pride Month
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution proclaiming September 2022 to be Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, and Queer Pride Month. The text describes no cost.

output.headline: Ratifies two appointments to the school facilities bond oversight committee for July 2022 to June 2024
output.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointments to the Measures B, J, and Y Independent Citizens' School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee. Andrea Dawson is appointed as a community-at-large member (first term) and Andrew Nelsen as a parent or guardian member (third term). Both terms run from July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2024.
